name: proto-blocks/oit-single-location
title: OIT Single Location
description: Office / single-location page header. Auto-derived breadcrumb, headline with highlight, supporting paragraph, phone + email + address rows on the left, Google Maps embed (keyless iframe, no API key) on the right.

highlightWord.label: Highlight word/phrase in title
highlightWord.help: First case-insensitive occurrence in the title is wrapped in a brand-red span.

mapEmbed.label: Google Maps embed
mapEmbed.help: Paste the embed code from Google Maps -> Share -> Embed a map (the whole <iframe> tag, or just its src URL). Leave empty to auto-generate a map from the coordinates below. No API key needed.

mapCenter.label: Map coordinates (lat,lng)
mapCenter.help: Fallback used only when no embed is pasted above. Comma-separated, e.g. 40.4406,-79.9959 for Pittsburgh.

mapZoom.label: Map zoom
mapZoom.help: Fallback zoom for the coordinates above. Higher = closer (12 ~ metro, 16 ~ street level).
